children: International Gemological Institute Ltd. (IGI) witnessed a large trade in the pre-open block window on Friday, November 27, where shares worth ₹281 crore changed hands between the sellers and the buyers.

As many as 67.16 lakh crore of the company changed hands in the block deal. Shares changed hands at a price of ₹417 per share. The company's promoter entity, BCP Asia II Topco Pte Ltd. is the likely seller in this transaction. The number of shares that changed hands amount to 1.55% of the total outstanding equity of the company, in-line with what was disclosed earlier.

On Thursday, the International Gemological Institute (IGI) informed the exchanges that its promoters BCP Asia II Topco Pte Ltd is looking at selling 67.16 lakh equity shares, or around 1.55% equity, of the company's total paid-up equity share capital to meet the minimum public shareholding requirements.
This was a confirmation of a CNBC-TV18 newsbreak from earlier in the day.
The proposed sale was to be conducted via a block deal window in one or more tranches.

The filing stated that IGI proposed the transaction would be completed within seven trading days from November 25, subject to the validity of the pre-clearance as well as the applicable regulatory requirements.
At the end of the September quarter, the promoter BCP Asia II Topco Pte Ltd held 76.55% stake in IGI, while the remaining 23.45% was held by public shareholders.
Following the proposed sale, the aggregate shareholding of the promoter is likely to decline below 75%, which will be in compliance with the Minimum Public Shareholding (MPS) norms.
On another note, last month, IGI's group CFO Eashwar Iyer told

that the company has raised its growth guidance post a strong performance in the first half of this fiscal. IGI is expecting natural diamond certification growth to reach double digits by the year-end, supported by festive demand and recovery in jewellery sales, Iyer said.
IGI shares ended the previous session 2% lower at ₹423.9 apiece. The stock has risen 8% in the past month 14.6% in the last six months and 27.3% this year, so far.

title: International Gemological Institute shares worth ₹281 crore change hands in pre-open block window
